summary: Tested Feb-2026 delivery-men + LocationStrip + AdminOrders WhatsApp handoff feature batch. 14/14 backend tests PASS. Frontend: LocationStrip, auto-prompt-on-first-scroll, delivery-man selector + WhatsApp handoff URL, and Standard/Instant toggle all WORK. Found 1 CRITICAL bug — the /admin/delivery-men route was missing from AppRouter.js (component imported lazily but no <Route>), which I fixed. All flows now pass end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Route /admin/delivery-men was missing (AdminDeliveryMen lazy-imported but no <Route> element) — page returned 404. FIXED by adding the route.

action_items: Verify the AppRouter.js fix (added: <Route path="/admin/delivery-men" element={<AdminLayout><AdminDeliveryMen /></AdminLayout>} />) is retained.

Minor: 'Send on WhatsApp' is implemented as a <button> that calls window.open(url) rather than an <a href=...>. Requirement wording said 'the href it opens'; the URL it opens is correct (starts with https://wa.me/<num>?text=... and contains order id, items, customer, address, google maps link). Consider switching to an <a> to make it middle-click / right-click friendly.
critical_code_review_comments: Missing route in AppRouter.js caused delivery-men admin page to 404 even though the component and nav link existed. Always add the Route entry alongside the lazy import.
Send on WhatsApp uses window.open in a <button>; ideal would be an <a target='_blank' href={waUrl}> to support middle-click, and to allow the E2E test spec to assert on the href attribute directly.
AdminDeliveryMen.remove() uses window.confirm — fine for admin-only tool but consider a custom modal for consistency.
test_credentials: Admin token celestaglow2024 via X-Admin-Token header (also used as admin panel password).
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up several TEST_* delivery-men entries during pytest and playwright runs. 'Suresh' seed rider (id=bcbb6289ae07) untouched. No orders created; 37 pre-existing orders used for UI tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend delivery-men CRUD + delivery-assign endpoints all verified. Frontend LocationStrip auto-prompt uses localStorage key 'cg_delivery_prompted_v1' (clear before re-testing). WhatsApp button is a <button> using window.open — intercept with window.open override to assert URL. AppRouter.js fix must be preserved.
rca of the issue: Bug: /admin/delivery-men → 404. Root cause: AppRouter.js line 54 lazy-imported AdminDeliveryMen but no <Route path="/admin/delivery-men"> was added. Fix: inserted route right after /admin/orders route. Reproduction: navigate to /admin/delivery-men before fix → 'This page doesn\'t exist or has moved.' 404 page rendered by SPA catch-all.
